On this big plot, I will use some chemical fertilizer but not at a very high rate, add manure where I can, and use improved seed because it gives better harvest when the rains are good. I will not irrigate, and I do not expect much pesticide use unless there is a real problem, but I will need some hired labor because the area is too large for family labor alone.
